Ivy: Quick drop  i brought Pretzel the hedgehog to the office for a 2-hr desk cameo 438 photo incoming
Marco: HEDGEHOG???? emergency walkover in 2 mins :running_man: :heart_eyes:
Ivy: uploaded: <https://imgur.com/a/pretzel-visit|pretzel_sleep.jpg>  he promptly curled into the tiniest cinnamon roll on a sticky note 
Dana: he looks like a burrito of soft opinion. can confirm heart melt :sob:
People-Ops Bot: Reminder: please register guest pets and upload care/vax info. Short visits (<3hrs) are allowed with consent from nearby desk neighbors. See https://intranet/pets
Ivy: registered Pretzel this morning and uploaded the care note (no handling without gloves, prefers dim light). also brought a tiny fleece nest. no quill incidents yet :sweat_smile:
Marco: poll: Pretzel's mood = 1) snoozy bun 2) skeptical noble 3) fast noodle. react with :one:/:two:/:three:
Dana: reacts with :one: and :two: 
Kai: votes :three: 609 tiny noodle is accurate when treats appear
Ivy: posted a 6s clip: <https://youtu.be/pretzel-twitch>  he did a micro-explore and then the full curl. sign on my desk: "Pretzel zone 43e be gentle"
Marco: offering to bring a small LED dimmer so Pretzel's light is cozy. also will bring a tiny "do not disturb: hedgehog nap" sign for the hallway
People-Ops Bot: Thanks for registering Pretzel, Ivy. If Pretzel becomes a recurring visitor, please submit a recurring pet form.
Ivy: leaving a schedule on the whiteboard for hourly photo drops. next nap update at 3:45 4f7
